feedback.end: Rainforests are tropical regions normally found around the equator.

instruction.text: Do you know what a rainforest looks like? Select different parts of the habitat to learn more.

hint.text: A habitat is an animal’s home. It can be large like a group of mountains or small like a pond.
hint.label: Habitat

feedback.correct: Rainforests get a lot of rain. That’s why they are called rainforests.
Rainforests are very green and lush forests with many beautiful plants and animals.
Rainforests are often foggy and humid: perfect weather for all the plants.

instruction.text: Which photo shows a rainforest? Select the correct picture.

feedback.correct: The world’s largest rainforest is the Amazon. The Amazon and other rainforest habitats are endangered by humans.
